_comment: Claude Code project settings.
UserPromptSubmit -> Superagent's user-query logger so the
Supertailor's friction-analysis log captures prompts regardless of
IDE. Mirrors .cursor/hooks.json. Disable by setting
workspace/_memory/config.yaml preferences.privacy.log_user_queries:
false. The --source flag tags each row so the Supertailor can slice
by IDE. .cursor/hooks.json relies on the script's default
(source=cursor).
PostToolUse -> Superagent's email archive bridge. Every Gmail MCP
tool call (send / read / search) is captured to the local archive
at workspace/_memory/email/ per contracts/email-capture.md. The
bridge reads the hook envelope from stdin, dispatches to the right
archive.capture_* helper, and always exits 0 (never blocks the
parent tool call). Disable by setting workspace/_memory/config.yaml
preferences.privacy.archive_emails: false.
UserPromptSubmit (second hook) -> Superagent's skill auto-loader.
Matches the prompt against every skill's frontmatter triggers
(superagent/skills/ + workspace/_custom/skills/) and injects the
matching skill (or a compact pointer + step index for long skills)
deterministically. Claude Code only (Cursor hooks cannot add
context). Fail-safe: always exits 0. Disable by setting
workspace/_memory/config.yaml preferences.skill_autoload: false.
Every command anchors itself to the repo root before running. Hooks are
not guaranteed any particular cwd, and the repo root is what makes
superagent.tools.* importable (the package is not installed into the
venv) and what anchors uv's relative cache-dir to ./.tmp.noSync/uv-cache
(rules/development-tooling.md). `unset VIRTUAL_ENV` silences uv's
env-mismatch warning when a shell has the deprecated ./.venv activated.
`|| exit 1` maps a failure to Claude Code's NON-BLOCKING error code:
the scripts' own main() always returns 0, but a process that cannot
start at all exits 2, which is the code that BLOCKS the prompt. Errors
stay visible on stderr -- they just never hold up a turn.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv.noSync uv run python -m superagent.tools.log_user_query --source claude-code || exit 1
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv.noSync uv run python -m superagent.tools.skill_loader || exit 1
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv.noSync uv run python -m superagent.tools.email.archive_hook --kind=sent || exit 1
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv.noSync uv run python -m superagent.tools.email.archive_hook --kind=inbound || exit 1
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv.noSync uv run python -m superagent.tools.email.archive_hook --kind=stubs || exit 1
